text: Make me a fitness app.
Build a budgeting app for students. It should track spending and help them save money.

Our support team spends too long finding answers. Make a searchable help center for new customers; success means cutting repeat tickets by 20% in 8 weeks. Keep the first version to the top 30 questions. Acceptance: search returns a useful article for at least 8 of 10 test queries. Use the existing docs as source material. Add a way to verify search quality.

For freelance designers who miss invoice follow-ups, make a reminder flow. First add invoice dates, then schedule reminders, then let the user snooze them. MVP excludes payment processing. Done means a user can create an invoice and receive a reminder on its due date. Use React and local storage. Test overdue invoices and snoozing.

Add a recipe planner for busy parents. Let them save recipes, plan 5 dinners, and export a grocery list. Keep it mobile-first and don't add social sharing yet. Acceptance: a parent can plan a week in under 2 minutes. Use the attached sketch as reference.
Make an app to help people sleep better. Include sleep tracking, meditation, a journal, an AI coach, wearable integrations, community challenges, and personalized reports. Make it polished.

For first-time renters, build a move-in checklist because people forget utility and address changes. Success: 70% of users finish the checklist within 3 days. Include 12 common tasks, due dates, and reminders. Don't build landlord accounts or payments. Acceptance: users can mark tasks complete and see overdue tasks. Use the attached sample checklist; check mobile layout at 360px.

Change the onboarding: 1) ask for a goal, 2) show 3 suggested routines, 3) let users skip setup. Out of scope: account linking. Success is 60% completion. Add tests for skip and back navigation. The current onboarding is in the Figma link.
The chart labels overlap on small screens. Fix it by wrapping labels under 320px and preserving the current desktop layout. Please check the empty-data state and add a visual regression test.
Fix it.
Make the dashboard better.

Build a lightweight appointment booking page for a neighborhood dentist. Patients currently call during office hours just to find an opening. Reduce booking calls by 25% in 6 weeks. First: show available slots; second: collect name and phone; third: send a confirmation. No insurance billing or patient accounts. Acceptance: a patient can book or cancel, and unavailable slots cannot be selected. Use the current brand guide. Keep page load under 1.5 seconds on 4G. Test empty slots and duplicate booking. Use Next.js and the existing scheduling API.

Users say the export is confusing. Rename the button to “Download CSV”, explain that filters apply, and keep the current export format. Don't change the data columns. Acceptance: 5 of 6 test users find the export without help. Please compare the result with the screenshot I attached.

Create a local-first reading list for researchers who save papers in too many places. Aim for 40% weekly active use after one month. MVP: add a URL, title, and tags; search saved items. Do not add social features or AI summaries. Acceptance: importing 100 links takes under 10 seconds and search returns matching titles. Use IndexedDB; handle duplicate URLs and offline use. Add a benchmark for import time.

For a small nonprofit, improve volunteer sign-up because people abandon the long form. Cut abandonment from 45% to 25% by next quarter. Build in this order: contact details, available shifts, confirmation email. Out of scope: background checks and donations. A completed sign-up must show a confirmation number. Use the attached form as the baseline and verify keyboard navigation.

Add a dark mode to the habit tracker. Keep contrast at WCAG AA, persist the choice, and respect the OS setting by default. Acceptance: all screens switch without a reload. Exclude custom themes. Check with keyboard and screen reader.

Users report that saving a draft sometimes loses text after a refresh. Reproduce with a 2,000-character draft, fix persistence, then verify the text survives refresh and offline restart. Preserve the existing editor behavior; don't add autosave indicators. Add regression tests for empty and long drafts.
Make a travel app with flights, hotels, maps, chat, bookings, loyalty points, and recommendations. Launch next month. Use whatever tech is fastest.

For remote workers, build a 10-minute break planner to reduce missed breaks. Target: 30% fewer skipped breaks in a 4-week pilot. Keep MVP to reminders and a simple weekly view. Acceptance: users can set quiet hours and snooze a reminder. Use browser notifications; handle denied permission and timezone changes. Test notification timing. Keep processing local with no account setup.
Ship whatever the assistant generated. Don't spend time checking edge cases or tests.
